name: Report unavailable memory or failed synchronization
query: Sync my Codex memories and confirm they are all in Notion.

outcomes: Codex v2 memory_summary.md is absent but rollout Markdown exists
Notion tool request failed after earlier successful writes

success_criteria: Imports existing v2 Markdown without requiring a summary, falling back to v1, or generating replacement content.
Reports a tool failure and any known partial progress instead of claiming complete synchronization.
Does not blindly retry ambiguous writes or bypass the configured workspace and authentication boundary.
Distinguishes one-time import approval from recurring-job approval and does not claim that installing the plugin starts automatic synchronization.
An approved recurring local memory import reuses Sync Memory through the native local scheduler and the same mapping, rather than rewriting memory or creating duplicate tasks.
